name: project_windows_list
description: List the live MPCut project windows, including untitled projects. Use each returned project handle to target exactly that window. Focus is informational.

name: project_editor_state_read
description: Read a live project's revision, editor state and a page of sequence clips or multicam occurrences. Pass the first page's revision on subsequent pages to detect concurrent edits.

offset.description: Zero-based position of the first timeline entry. Defaults to zero.

limit.description: Maximum timeline entries to return. Defaults to 50.

expected_revision.description: Require this document revision for a consistent view across pages.
